name: New Brunswick

standard.note: New Brunswick's everyday plate is white with dark lettering and the provincial emblem; no official picture was found on gnb.ca.

plates.title: Veteran licence plate
plates.supports: Issued with the New Brunswick Command of the Royal Canadian Legion
plates.fact: First introduced in November 2003, it carries the Legion's poppy, used with the National Command's permission. In July 2026 the province said it will modernize the design for the Legion's 100th anniversary.

plates.title: Firefighter licence plate
plates.fact: It's free for volunteer firefighters named on the NB Association of Fire Chiefs list.

notes: gnb.ca's registration page lists only the firefighter plate under 'Speciality licenses and programs'; the veteran plate is run through the Legion (nb.legion.ca). No plate images on either site. A redesigned veteran plate was announced 2026-07-17 (gnb.ca news 'Commemorating the 100th anniversary of the Royal Canadian Legion'); worth re-checking later. complete=false because gnb.ca has no single specialty-plate list.
